items: One Lua script refills by elapsed time, spends a token if available, writes back — one round trip, ~0.5ms
Extreme scale: shard buckets by client key, or sync a local approximate counter to Redis periodically

items: Fail open (allow) for a customer-facing API; fail closed for an abuse-prone endpoint
Alternatives: fixed window allows a 2x edge burst; sliding-window log is accurate but costs memory
